00.short_title: Fifteen Lessons from the Surah of the Cave | Qur'an 18:13 #shorts
00.description:
Fifteen lessons from the Surah of the Cave.
In Surah Al-Kahf, Allah says of the cave youths that He relates their story in truth.
A cave, two gardens, a journey, a wall.
Start with the cave.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:13 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs
00.chapter_label: 0. Intro: the surah of the cave

01.short_title: Young Men, One Cave, and One Prayer | Qur'an 18:10, 18:14 #shorts
01.description:
Young men, one cave, and one prayer.
A few young men retreat to a cave and ask Allah for mercy and right guidance. Then they stand up, and Allah makes their hearts firm.
Ask. Then stand firm.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:10, 18:14 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

02.short_title: They Looked Awake. They Were Asleep for Three Hundred Years | Qur'an 18:18, 18:25 #shorts
02.description:
They looked awake. They were asleep for three hundred years.
Allah says He turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance, and that they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.
Even asleep, they were not forgotten.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:18, 18:25 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

03.short_title: Never Say 'I'll Do It Tomorrow' Without This | Qur'an 18:23-24 #shorts
03.description:
Never say "I'll do it tomorrow" without this.
Allah teaches how to talk about tomorrow: add "If Allah wills", and remember your Lord when you forget.
Say: in sha Allah.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:23-24 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

04.short_title: He Had Two Gardens, and It Went to His Head | Qur'an 18:32, 18:34 #shorts
04.description:
He had two gardens, and it went to his head.
Allah gives the example of two men: one was granted two gardens of grapevines, bordered with palm trees, with crops between them, and he said, "I am greater than you in wealth."
A gift is not a rank.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:32, 18:34 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

05.short_title: Everything He Bragged About Was Gone | Qur'an 18:39, 18:42 #shorts
05.description:
Everything he bragged about was gone.
His friend told him what to say on entering his garden: "What Allah willed has occurred; there is no power except in Allah." Then his fruits were encompassed by ruin.
Say it while you have it.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:39, 18:42 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

06.short_title: Allah Compares This World to a Rainstorm | Qur'an 18:45 #shorts
06.description:
Allah compares this world to a rainstorm.
He gives the example of the life of this world: like rain sent down from the sky, the vegetation mingles with it, then it becomes dry remnants scattered by the winds.
Hold it lightly.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:45 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

07.short_title: Wealth and Children Are an Adornment. What Lasts? | Qur'an 18:46, 18:30 #shorts
07.description:
Wealth and children are called an adornment. What lasts?
Allah says the enduring good deeds are better for reward and better for hope, and that He will not allow the reward of any who did well in deeds to be lost.
Invest in what stays.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:46, 18:30 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

08.short_title: He Would Not Stop Traveling Until He Found a Teacher | Qur'an 18:60, 18:65 #shorts
08.description:
He wouldn't stop traveling until he found a teacher.
Musa says he will not cease until he reaches the junction of the two seas, and they find a servant from among Allah's servants who had been taught a knowledge from Him.
Keep learning.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:60, 18:65 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

09.short_title: Losing the Fish Was What He Was Looking For | Qur'an 18:61, 18:64 #shorts
09.description:
Losing the fish was exactly what he was looking for.
At the junction of the two seas they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea. Musa said, "That is what we were seeking," and they returned, following their footprints.
Retrace your steps.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:61, 18:64 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

10.short_title: He Damaged a Poor People's Boat. Wait for the Reason | Qur'an 18:71, 18:79 #shorts
10.description:
He damaged a poor people's boat. Wait for the reason.
Musa objects when the servant tears the boat open. Then the servant explains: it belonged to poor people working at sea, and there was a king after them who seized every good ship by force.
Wait for the reason.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:71, 18:79 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

11.short_title: Musa Was Shocked. Then He Heard the Other Side | Qur'an 18:80-81 #shorts
11.description:
Musa was shocked. Then he heard the other side.
The servant explains about the boy: his parents were believers, and they feared he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief, so their Lord would substitute one better in purity and nearer to mercy.
Trust the bigger picture.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:80-81 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

12.short_title: A Town Refused Them Food. He Repaired Its Wall Anyway | Qur'an 18:82 #shorts
12.description:
A town refused them food. He repaired its wall anyway.
Allah says the wall belonged to two orphan boys in the city, with a treasure beneath it, and their father had been righteous. So their Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy.
Do good anyway.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:82 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

13.short_title: He Was Given a Way to Everything. See What He Chose | Qur'an 18:84, 18:88 #shorts
13.description:
He was given a way to everything. See what he chose.
Allah says He established Dhul-Qarnayn upon the earth and gave him to everything a way. For the one who believes and does righteousness, there is a reward of Paradise, and ease from His command.
Power is a choice.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:84, 18:88 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

14.short_title: He Built a Wall of Iron, Then Gave the Credit Away | Qur'an 18:95, 18:98 #shorts
14.description:
He built an iron wall, then gave the credit away.
When a people ask for a barrier, Dhul-Qarnayn says what his Lord has established him in is better, and asks them to assist him with strength. Of the finished dam he says, "This is a mercy from my Lord."
Give the credit away.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:95, 18:98 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

15.short_title: If the Sea Were Ink, It Would Still Run Out | Qur'an 18:109 #shorts
15.description:
If the sea were ink, it would still run out.
Allah says that if the sea were ink for writing the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if He brought the like of it as a supplement.
Stay humble.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:109 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

16.short_title: Fifteen Lessons from the Surah of the Cave (Surah Al-Kahf) | Qur'an 18:110 #shorts
16.description:
That was the Surah of the Cave.
Allah says whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord.
Faith. Wealth. Knowledge. Power. Start again from the cave.

Qur'an, Surah Al-Kahf 18:110 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahalkahf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

long_form.title: Surah Al-Kahf: 15 Lessons from the Surah of the Cave (Quran 18)
long_form.description:
Surah Al-Kahf (Qur'an 18) tells of young men who retreat to a cave, the owner of two gardens, Musa and a servant of Allah, and Dhul-Qarnayn. This video walks through it in 15 short lessons, in the order of the surah: the cave prayer, the long sleep, "if Allah wills", the two gardens, the rain parable, what lasts, the teacher, the fish, the boat, the boy, the wall, the journeys, the iron barrier and the ink. Every Qur'an line on screen is the Saheeh International translation. No faces are shown.
